subject.title: Native apps should inject live widget theme tokens (iOS/macOS/Android)

question: Should the native apps expose a shared app-owned widget-token mapping, or should each platform derive the existing snapshot independently from its own active theme system?
rationale: Both approaches can use the existing validated receiver, but the choice determines long-term ownership, how custom theme families remain synchronized, and where compatibility tests belong.

options.title: Shared typed mapping
options.body: Define one canonical native widget-token mapping and have iOS, macOS, and Android adapt their active theme values into that contract.

options.title: Platform-local mappings
options.body: Let each native app derive the allowlisted snapshot independently, accepting separate maintenance and drift-prevention tests.

recommendation.title: Shared typed mapping
recommendation.body: Define one canonical native widget-token mapping and have iOS, macOS, and Android adapt their active theme values into that contract.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work created the widget token contract and explicitly scoped native injection as its follow-up.
